entries.subject: EngineCapabilities.spi_version=1 and inferred SPI v1 engines
entries.replacement: Declare EngineCapabilities(spi_version=2) and implement the public SPI v2 outcomes and snapshots.
entries.impact: External engines relying on inferred capabilities will no longer adapt automatically.
entries.migration: Run the SPI v2 conformance profile and replace every inferred capability with an explicit declaration.

entries.subject: mongoeco.engines.adapter.LegacyEngineAdapter
entries.replacement: EngineSpiAdapter with an engine declaring SPI v2 capabilities.
entries.impact: Imports or type checks against the legacy adapter will fail after removal.
entries.migration: Depend on the public engine contract and conformance runner instead of the adapter implementation type.

entries.subject: put_document
entries.impact: Boolean insert results do not carry images or commit sequence evidence.
entries.migration: Implement insert_document and return an owned InsertOutcome for applied and non-applied writes.

entries.subject: put_documents_bulk
entries.replacement: insert_documents returning a tuple of InsertOutcome values.
entries.impact: Legacy partial batches cannot express complete per-item commit evidence.
entries.migration: Declare batch_inserts and implement insert_documents, or declare it false and use the canonical single-insert fallback.

entries.subject: Legacy engine mutation callbacks through on_commit
entries.replacement: Typed outcomes plus change_delivery none, commit-sequence or transactional-outbox.
entries.impact: Callback timing does not prove transaction commit or durable delivery.
entries.migration: Choose and declare one change delivery strategy, then publish only through its SPI v2 primitives.

entries.subject: capture_document mutation flag
entries.impact: The optional flag makes result shape depend on a private caller convention.
entries.migration: Always return the deleted image in an applied SPI v2 DeleteOutcome.

entries.subject: capture_documents mutation flag
entries.impact: The optional flag creates context-dependent return contracts.
entries.migration: Always return required before and after images in an applied SPI v2 MutationOutcome.

entries.subject: supports_injected_clock capability inference
entries.impact: A private attribute can contradict the declared engine contract.
entries.migration: Declare injected_clock in the immutable EngineCapabilities value.

entries.subject: search_documents and explain_search_documents engine methods
entries.replacement: execute_search and explain_search using SearchRequest and SearchExecutionOutcome.
entries.impact: Legacy methods merge BSON documents and runtime metadata and cannot consume the immutable plan.
entries.migration: Declare SearchEngineCapabilities and implement the typed Search SPI methods.

entries.subject: Automatic virtual searchHighlights output field
entries.impact: Implicit materialization makes a generated field resemble caller BSON.
entries.migration: Project or copy highlight metadata explicitly with $meta before it is needed.

entries.subject: countPreview explain alias
entries.replacement: Typed collector metadata and canonical Search execution metrics.
entries.impact: The preview is a duplicate projection rather than an extensible result contract.
entries.migration: Read count collector output and its typed metrics from the canonical Search nodes.

entries.subject: facetPreview explain alias
entries.impact: The preview duplicates typed facet buckets and limits future collector evolution.
entries.migration: Consume typed named or simple facet collector results.

entries.subject: highlightPreview explain alias
entries.replacement: SearchHit runtime metadata and SearchHighlightPassage values.
entries.impact: The preview samples metadata through a second observable shape.
entries.migration: Consume highlight passages from canonical hit metadata or explicit $meta projection.

entries.subject: matchedCount executionStats alias
entries.impact: The unqualified name conflates query matches, returned hits and pipeline output.
entries.migration: Read queryMatchedCount and inspect its domain, availability and exactness.

entries.subject: Executed SearchExecutionTrace without bound context or captured snapshot
entries.replacement: Executed traces with operation_id, execution_context_bound and snapshot_captured evidence.
entries.impact: A trace without causal evidence cannot prove which execution it describes.
entries.migration: Construct traces from SearchRequest and the snapshot used by the engine.

entries.subject: dialect, collation, let and context duplicated on executable operations
entries.replacement: A future versioned bound-operation contract with OperationContext as the sole semantic source.
entries.impact: Changing these public DTOs would require a separately versioned SPI contract.
entries.migration: No migration is required in 4.x; await the accepted SPI v3 transition contract.
